title: Stability of Extremal Critical Collapse
exact_target: Determine whether asymptotically extremal black holes form a hypersurface separating complete evolution from collapse near the known critical family.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006047 (OWR-14298591-011). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/36, pp. 2033--2112. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The known family $D_{\lambda_*}$ and its matter model are those of the source. A hypersurface must be defined in an appropriate data topology, not inferred merely from one one-parameter threshold.
